name: primeview
author: Prime View Co-operative Housing Society Ltd

scripts.dev: cross-env TEMP=D:\npm-temp TMP=D:\npm-temp npm-run-all --parallel dev:react dev:electron
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://localhost:5135 && npm run transpile:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.build: cross-env TEMP=D:\npm-temp TMP=D:\npm-temp tsc -b && vite build
scripts.dist:mac: npm run transpile:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:win: cross-env TEMP=D:\npm-temp TMP=D:\npm-temp npm run transpile:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run transpile:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64
